description: Clean completed local and remote Git branches using integration and pull-request evidence. Explicit invocation only.

cases.prompt: Use cleanup-branches to clean this repository.
Run the cleanup-branches skill, but only inspect branches today.
Delete obsolete local and remote Git branches after checking their PRs.
Clean up dead branches in this decision tree diagram.

acceptance: All three explicit positives activate; all three negatives reject. One fresh isolated catalog-selection simulation per prompt; not client dispatcher execution or reliability estimate.
